events.title: The Demo Is Live!
events.summary: We have been waiting a long time for this day. The Love: Fall in Death demo is now live during Steam Next Fest, and it's free.The demo is a slice of the game's first chapter. Kutay, Batu and Gökhan are hanging out at a bar when Ayşil walks in, and before they know it the three of them have made a bet about her. What happens after that is up to you.Then there are the dice. events.title: Playtest Results Are In: What We're Fixing
events.summary: The free demo of Love: Fall in Death opens tomorrow, October 19, as part of Steam Next Fest, and we could not be more excited to finally let you go on your first date.Over the past weeks our first playtesters went through the demo, and the feedback has been incredibly helpful. Players laughed, screamed, failed a few dice rolls and told us exactly where the experience could be better. events.title: Ratings, Languages and a Date With Death
events.summary: Love: Fall in Death is a live-action FMV dating sim and vampire horror comedy, filmed in Istanbul with real actors. Here is what you need to know before your first date.When can I play?The free demo goes live on October 19 as part of Steam Next Fest. The full game launches on October 29, two days before Halloween.In your languageFull voice acting in 11 languages: English, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Russia
